name: Pemberton's Gourmet Foods
old_description: Pemberton’s core values aren’t just words. They guide every aspect of our work—and have for over two decades.
about:
Pemberton's Gourmet Foods operates from Gray, Maine, where it has served as a contract manufacturing partner for food brands across New England for more than two decades. The company was founded to provide co-packing and private-label services to restaurateurs and consumer-packaged-goods entrepreneurs, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The facility specializes in hot-fill and cold-fill production of sauces, salsas, preserves, jams, jellies, mustards, relishes, condiments, marinades, dessert toppings, tapenades, chutneys, and salad dressings. Services extend beyond filling to include product development, process-review coordination, and ingredient and nutritional labeling. The company also produces its own line of specialty foods sold through retail outlets in Maine and the Northeast.

Customers range from independent food entrepreneurs and restaurant owners to established CPG brands and food brokers. A noted partnership includes Reny's, a 19-location Maine department store that develops private-label products with Pemberton's. Testimonials cite reliability on rush orders and protection of proprietary formulations.

The company emphasizes guaranteed craftsmanship, customer-first service, and confidentiality of client recipes as its differentiating principles. It holds SQF certification and positions itself as a start-to-finish partner that manages production details so clients can focus on brand growth.
